is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses transgenic Drosophila melanogaster strains, not Anopheles mosquitoes.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study does not genotype Anopheles mosquitoes for resistance markers; it uses genetically engineered Drosophila lines.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data for field-collected Anopheles mosquitoes is reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses laboratory-reared transgenic Drosophila melanogaster strains.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study testing insecticide formulations on transgenic Drosophila.

sub_country_location.evidence: Not applicable as no field populations were studied.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Not applicable as no field populations were studied.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses laboratory-generated transgenic Drosophila strains.

supplement.evidence: The study does not involve field-collected mosquito data.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of insecticide mixtures (Fludora Fusion) and transfluthrin against transgenic Drosophila melanogaster strains engineered to express resistance mechanisms (target-site mutations and P450 enzymes) relevant to mosquitoes. It does not involve field-collected Anopheles mosquitoes or genotyping of field populations.
